The '''Bontraar residence''' was the home of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] businessman [[Elwis Bontraar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When Elwis's daughter [[Jennalyn Bontraar|Jennalyn]] was kidnapped by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Zascha]] as revenge for her [[Anoura|sister's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], the kidnapper sent a ransom letter to the Bontraar residence demanding 1,000 [[Credit chip/Legends|cred sticks]] for their daughter's safe return.
